static_call_arithmetic_scope: For each accepted checkpoint, exact6f ingress.rs lines2573-2575 invokes KernelBudget::verify. host_kernel_parent.rs check() performs fresh boot and current-thread cgroup reads, fresh reads of five limit files, and parent symlink_metadata. Seven opens, at least fourteen nonempty-plus-EOF Read calls, and one parent metadata call per accepted check are source operation arithmetic, not a measured syscall trace or isolated I/O timing. No count or frequency is changed.
conclusions: The repeated checkpoint Host verification path is a measured multi-second component: campaign baseline CPU 4.563092387 to 4.585642696 seconds, wall 6.185134145 to 6.834905309 seconds for 82,925 to 82,935 accepted calls. This is the original frozen 6f measurement, not current44d performance.
The observer does not isolate open/read/metadata, UTF-8 validation, membership parsing, or numeric parsing. Fresh-I/O dominance is a source-backed hypothesis, not a measured attribution.

Host CPU records the current CPU clock of each invoking thread, including scoped workers that call the wrapper; it is not full worker CPU accounting. Client-import and account_graph CPU are calling-thread observations with different scopes. Do not subtract them or present Host/caller ratios as exclusive proportions. Host wall intervals can overlap across workers; do not add them to enclosing import, graph, or phase intervals.

All 57 valid Host observers have zero rejected and unfinished Host calls, yet six outer imports are observed failures. Accepted Host verification does not establish successful import, durable publication, confirmation, or business acceptance. Two missing-or-invalid rows keep their complete phase cost totals null.

numeric() and validate_limits() already parse short text without heap allocation. A whole-input canonical numeric fast path with the original common range checks and full original fallback is semantically possible, but no present measurement establishes a material benefit. No native change is selected or created from this old-source readback.
